finalText:
**Found it — `engine.js` was rounding the price to cents too early.**

It rounded the USD subtotal right after the percent coupon, before changing currency. A 10% cut off `$19.98` leaves `$17.982`. That got cut to `$17.98`, and the exchange rate then blew the missing fraction up past a half-cent.

That's why most carts looked fine. It only shows when the dropped fraction happens to cross a rounding line, so USD and EUR passed while GBP, CAD and JPY failed. Every bad total was low, never high, so the store was eating the cent.

I moved the rounding to the end, once, in the cart's own currency. All 40 tests pass, 0.09s.

One thing I left alone: a `FLAT15` coupon on a small cart still gives a negative total. It's not what Finance flagged, and nothing clamps it at zero.
